items.title: EU gas storage is 75% filled
items.description: In summer 2026, disruptions to liquefied natural gas (LNG) flows linked to the conflict in the Middle East, low gas storage levels after winter 2025-2026 and slower refilling contributed to tighter supply and pushed the EU’s gas prices higher.

items.title: Commission launches T-MED Investment Platform with up to €4.5 billion in EU guarantees
items.description: Today, the European Commission launched the T-MED Investment Platform, to mobilise large-scale investment in renewable energy and clean technologies across the Mediterranean.

items.title: CEF Energy 2026 call for PCI/PMI projects attracts strong interest with 67 applications requesting €2.88 billion
items.description: The Commission has received 67 applications for cross-border energy infrastructure projects requesting €2.88 billion in EU co-funding under the Connecting Europe Facility (CEF) Energy programme.

items.title: Hydrogen Strategy – Commission launches consultation
items.description: The European Commission has today launched a 4-week call for evidence and a 4-week targeted stakeholder consultation to gather input to help shape the forthcoming Hydrogen Strategy.

items.title: Commissioner Jørgensen in Hungary to address high energy prices, energy security and housing
items.description: Tomorrow, Commissioner for Energy and Housing Dan Jørgensen will be in Budapest, Hungary, to meet with national authorities, energy operators and other stakeholders

items.title: Oil Coordination Group discusses EU fuel market developments
items.description: Experts from the European Commission, EU countries, the International Energy Agency (IEA) and the Energy Community met yesterday in the Oil Coordination Group to take stock of the recent developments in fuels markets.

items.title: Commission welcomes political agreement on rules enhancing stability and long-term resilience of EU carbon market
items.description: The European Commission welcomes the provisional political agreement reached by the European Parliament and the Council on a targeted amendment to strengthen the Market Stability Reserve (MSR) of the EU's Emissions Trading System (EU ETS).

items.title: EU and New Caledonia sign strategic partnership on sustainable raw materials
items.description: Today, the European Commission and the government of New Caledonia signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) establishing a strategic partnership on sustainable raw materials value chains.

items.title: Commission invests €3.4 billion in net-zero technology projects
items.description: Today, the European Commission has selected 77 European net-zero technology projects to receive funding support worth €3.4 billion under the call of the Innovation Fund, launched in December 2025.

items.title: Eurostat: EU trade in wind turbines increased in 2025
items.description: EU-produced wind turbines had an export value of €3.1 billion in 2025, relative to imports of €0.7 billion. Compared with the previous year, exports increased both in value (10.8%) and volume (9.5%).

items.title: Commissioner Jørgensen in Slovakia to discuss energy prices and security with Visegrad Energy Ministers and continue his Affordable Housing Tour
items.description: On Monday, 19 October, Commissioner for Energy and Housing Dan Jørgensen will be in Bratislava, Slovakia, to discuss high energy prices and security of supply with the energy ministers of the Visegrad Group (Czechia, Hungary, Poland and Slovakia).
